preprocessing_summary: 应用 EXIF 方向后转为 RGB；官方双线性缩放至 224×224；像素除以 255；均值与标准差均为 [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]。
limitations: Research and education only; not approved or validated for clinical diagnosis.
Accuracy is author-reported, not independently reproduced on an external patient-level cohort.
Training dataset provenance and patient-level separation are insufficiently documented.
Single 2D brain MRI raster slices only. Not a CT, DICOM-volume, segmentation or general image model.
Softmax scores are uncalibrated model scores, not clinical diagnostic probabilities.
The40 public example comparison is small and may overlap source training data; it is not clinical validation.
